meta.title: Scenario: silent leaders (Quarry Lane Partners)
meta.notes: Fictional data, generated by scripts/generate-merged-scenarios.ts (silent-leaders) with seed 20261108. Partial response combined with asymmetric ratings. 22 members in four teams. The four partners (PAR01–PAR04) and the Analysis lead (ANA01) did not respond, so 17 of 22 did; colleagues rated them. Members two or more levels junior rate seniors higher than seniors would rate them; ADV04 rates every colleague generously and ANA05 harshly; Operations members depend on PAR04 for sign-off and rate them strongly, with no rating in return.
